cards.body: Hair is mostly keratin, a protein. Steady daily protein gives the follicle its building blocks.
cards.title: Why protein matters

cards.body: Short sleep raises stress hormones, which can push more follicles into the shedding phase.
cards.title: Sleep and shedding

cards.body: Wet hair stretches and breaks easily. Pat dry, don't rub, and detangle from the ends up.
cards.title: Be gentle when wet

cards.body: The scan organizes evidence. It never diagnoses — your dermatologist makes the decisions.
cards.title: What a Root Scan is not

coach.disclaimer: Coaching is habit support only — never medical advice. Your dermatologist's plan always comes first.
nudges: Massage your scalp gently for 5 minutes — no nails, just fingertips.
Keep tonight's hair tie loose — tight styles pull at the roots.
Rinse with lukewarm water, not hot — hot water dries the scalp.
Add one protein source to today's meals — lentils, eggs, milk or meat.
No phone 30 minutes before sleep — your Stress & Sleep root will thank you.
coach.sub: Small daily nudges for your hair-care routine.
coach.title: Habit coach

home.intro1: Let's find the root cause of your hair fall — not just the symptom. The Root Scan is a 4-stage story: your kahani, your photos, and six roots — and every case is reviewed by a real dermatologist.
home.intro2: This is not a boring quiz. We organize the evidence; your doctor makes the decisions.
